title: user-unfriendly and poorly designed
text: This app is not fine at all-it is deeply user-unfriendly in every single aspect. Basic tasks like making an FPS transfer by phone number are a nightmare because the input fields and cursor are completely unresponsive, requiring endless taps just to type a number. The entire UI/UX feels broken, clunky, and frustrating to use on a daily basis. Standard Chartered really needs a complete overhaul of this app.

title: Should be banned from use
text: I have never come across a more unreliable, awful banking app. You can make the app look nice but if it regularly times out when you use QR Cash. Also there are many outages, it’s literally 9pm on a Thursday night and yet again for the second time this month it’s inaccessible because of “maintenance”. Cannot get cash out, cannot pay bills. Also regularly it fails to register advanced payments and regularly times out when you want to take cash out. Absolute trash. I cannot believe the HKMA tolerates this rubbish. For a multibillion dollar bank, someone really needs to lose their job over this.
